_purpose: Validate the QA-only FPD video-metric mapping candidate against the live V3 model before production review.

custom_checks.name: fpd_video_views_match_source
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS(COALESCE(SUM(IF(qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'fpd_original', _video_views, 0)), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(views) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.fpd_data_ranged_shortcutsFolder` WHERE DATE(date_final) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND CURRENT_DATE() AND package_id IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS value FROM {table}

custom_checks.name: fpd_video_completions_match_source
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS(COALESCE(SUM(IF(qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'fpd_original', _video_comps, 0)), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(completed_views) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.fpd_data_ranged_shortcutsFolder` WHERE DATE(date_final) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND CURRENT_DATE() AND package_id IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS value FROM {table}

custom_checks.name: dcm_video_metrics_preserved
custom_checks.sql: SELECT GREATEST(ABS(COALESCE(SUM(IF(qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'dcm', _video_views, 0)), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(IF(qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'dcm', _video_views, 0)) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.data_model_v3` WHERE _date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND CURRENT_DATE()), 0)), ABS(COALESCE(SUM(IF(qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'dcm', _video_comps, 0)), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(IF(qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'dcm', _video_comps, 0)) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.data_model_v3` WHERE _date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND CURRENT_DATE()), 0))) AS value FROM {table}
